name: Statute Fist
description: Throw a fist that lands as the plain letter of a law and carries its authority into the target.

name: Statute Guard
description: Hold a guard that the law forbids any blow to break and let the shell of will uphold the rule.

name: Statute Stride
description: Move by a ruled pace that the body keeps exactly because the command has made it law.

name: Ordained Press
description: Bear down on the opponent with an ordained weight that the body feels as a rule it must obey.

name: Ordained Ward
description: Hold a ward ordained against harm that the force of every blow is bound to respect.

name: Ordained Rousing
description: Ordain the allies near to stand firm and let the order lend each of them a steadier will.

name: Ordained Pardon
description: Pardon an ally from a binding or a curse by ruling it void and driving it out of the mind.

name: Ordinance Crash
description: Bring an ordinance down as one blow that strikes the foe and presses their qi beneath the rule.

name: Ordinance Shell
description: Spread the ordinance over the nearby allies so that a ruled shell stands over each of them.

name: Edict Absolute
description: Pronounce an edict that admits no appeal so every foe in the field is pressed flat beneath it.

name: Lawful Verdict
description: streams: Will + Order; fuse a command into a law and let the whole field obey it as the force of one great sentence.

name: Animus Fist
description: Throw a fist in which the living spirit and the will move as a single weight.

name: Animus Guard
description: Hold a guard that the spirit and the will harden together against the blow.

name: Animus Stride
description: Stride as though the spirit led the body by the hand and the will pulled the spirit along.

name: Animus Sense
description: Reach out with spirit and will together and feel the living minds near as soft points of warmth.

name: Animus Press
description: Press on the opponent's spirit and will together until both sink and the body follows.

name: Animus Ward
description: Hold a ward woven of spirit and will that turns away force and hostile intent alike.

name: Animus Lend
description: Lend a measure of spirit and will to an ally whose own strength is running out.

name: Animus Cleansing
description: Wash the clinging marks of a hostile spirit from an ally with the joined force of spirit and will.

name: Animus Smite
description: Smite the foe with the joined weight of spirit and will so that body and nerve both reel.

name: Animus Revival
description: Pour joined spirit and will into a person whose breath has just stopped and call the heart back.

name: Animus Mandate
description: Send the joined force at the foe's own spirit as a mandate that no outer guard can stop.

name: Soulwill Manifest
description: streams: Will + Soul; let the will take the shape of the living spirit and strike as a single manifest presence.

name: Appointed Fist
description: Throw a fist at the hour it was appointed to land and trust the will to bring it there.

name: Appointed Guard
description: Raise the guard at the very moment the blow is appointed to fall and not a heartbeat sooner.

name: Appointed Stride
description: Stride so that the body arrives exactly when the will has appointed it to be there.

name: Appointed Foresight
description: Feel along the lines of the appointed hour and glimpse which strike is coming a breath ahead.

name: Appointed Press
description: Press on the opponent with a will that insists the outcome is already settled.

name: Appointed Ward
description: Hold a ward that the will has appointed to stand and that the blows are fated to fail against.

name: Appointed Spur
description: Tell an ally that the hour is theirs and let the force of the telling spur their will to take it.

name: Appointed Release
description: Declare an ally free of a laid curse or compulsion and let the will make the declaration true.

name: Appointed Blow
description: Land a blow that was always going to land and that no guard can arrive early enough to stop.

name: Appointed Shell
description: Appoint the nearby allies to survive the hour and shelter each under a will that makes it so.

name: Appointed Unravelling
description: Unravel a long-laid curse from an ally by willing the thread of it to come undone.

name: Destiny Decree
description: Decree the outcome of the fight aloud so the foes near are pressed flat by the weight of what is appointed.

name: Fated Verdict
description: streams: Will + Fate; will an outcome so firmly that fate bends to it and the foe falls where the verdict says.

name: Destiny Compelled
description: streams: Will + Fate; compel the lines of destiny to run through one point and let the foe meet their appointed end there.
